title: ProposalDecided v1 payload
description: What became of a Coach recommendation (RecommendationProposed): the user accepted it (it was applied as a new strategy version) or rejected it, or a newer recommendation for the same goal replaced it before the user decided.

note.description: The user's reason, when they gave one (usually for a rejection)

strategyVersionId.description: The strategy version the proposal became; set only when ACCEPTED
